description: This file defines the BodySummarizer class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, which implements message body summarization functionality for HTTP messages.

classes.name: BodySummarizer
classes.description: Implements BodySummarizerInterface to provide summarized representations of HTTP message bodies, optionally truncated.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor allowing optional truncation length setting.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Returns a summarized message body, either full or truncated based on configuration.
